133384.overview: Super Mahjong is a 1v1 mahjong game for one player.

160615.overview: In single combat, or in 4-man wrestling, you must defeat your opponent according to the rules of the art: Cuffs, arm locks, throws or immobilizations are part of the technique of the champion you choose.

163765.overview: This adventure takes place successively in an underground, in a cave, and in the jungle. You are Lupin and you run in search of diamonds. But beware, crocodiles, vultures, snakes and tree trunks are chasing you. Either jump over them or destroy them with your fist. During the fourth phase, you are in a room in which you have to shoot at moving targets in order to be able to escape. So hurry yourself and don't waste a minute, because time is precious. For one or two players.
